messages:
alex (eng-sre): Postmortem uploaded — thanks everyone for the quick turn. Quick follow-ups: we need a final statuspage blurb, decide whether the RCA is public, and owners + dates for the remediation action items.

maya (product): Agreed. Can we draft a short statuspage line that avoids jargon but signals progress? cc @support for customer-facing phrasing.

owen (support): Suggestion: keep it simple. Something like: 'Degraded text-generation performance in EU region on 2026-03-14; impact resolved. We’re rolling a fix and will monitor. See details/RCA when available.' 

alex (eng-sre): Nice. Two asks: 1) should we link to the full RCA from the status page or link only to a summary? 2) timeline for action items so we can commit to customers.

maya (product): I'd prefer summary on status page + link to full RCA later. Full RCA should be gated by legal/security signoff if it contains configs or logs.

lena (security): Correct — redact any customer identifiers and internal keys. We're comfortable with a public summary now. For full RCA, we need to review redactions.

jess (ops): On action items: I propose owners and 2-week cadence. From PM/eng list in the postmortem: 1) fix autoscaler threshold (owner: jess) - ETA 2026-03-28; 2) add anomaly alerting for KV cache fill rate (owner: alex) - ETA 2026-03-21; 3) retro on deployment process (owner: maya) - ETA 2026-04-04.

alex (eng-sre): I'll take the anomaly alerting. I also want to flag recurring pattern: we saw a similar KV cache saturation in Oct 2025. We should mark that as a recurring incident and consider a larger mitigation (config defaults + improved OOM handling).

owen (support): If it's recurring, we should call that out in the summary — customers need to know we're addressing root cause, not just this occurrence. But be careful with language: 'recurring' vs 'isolated regression'.

maya (product): Draft statuspage blurb for review: 

```
Mar 14 2026 — Degraded text-generation performance in EU region. We resolved the impact by reverting a deployment and applying a temporary autoscaler adjustment. Customers may have experienced higher latency or rate limits during the incident. We’re working on long-term mitigations; a summary RCA will be published when security review is complete.
```

alex (eng-sre): That reads well. Minor tweak: replace 'reverting a deployment' with 'rolling back a model variant' — more precise.

maya (product): Updated: 

```
Mar 14 2026 — Degraded text-generation performance in EU region. We resolved the impact by rolling back a model variant and applying a temporary autoscaler adjustment. Customers may have experienced higher latency or rate limits during the incident. We’re implementing long-term mitigations to prevent recurrence; a summary RCA will be published after security review.
```

lena (security): OK from security for the summary. Please open a ticket for the full-RCA review (include redaction checklist).

incidents-bot: Created follow-up tickets: INF-4521 (autoscaler threshold), INF-4522 (KV cache alerting), INF-4523 (deployment retro). First comment links to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-14-kv-cache-saturation

jess (ops): I'll own INF-4521. Setting checkpoint meeting for 2026-03-25 to review progress.

owen (support): Once the summary is live, I'll prepare a customer-facing note for affected accounts and share templates for CS to use.

alex (eng-sre): Action items recap (short):
- INF-4521 owner=jess ETA=2026-03-28 (autoscaler)
- INF-4522 owner=alex ETA=2026-03-21 (KV cache alerts)
- INF-4523 owner=maya ETA=2026-04-04 (deployment retro)
- Full RCA review owner=lena ETA=2026-03-22 (redaction + security signoff)

maya (product): I'll queue the statuspage update once INF-4523 is created and we have security signoff for the summary link.

owen (support): small ask — can we include a short FAQ line for customers: 'Will this affect model quality or stored data?' Answer: 'No known data loss; quality restored to pre-incident levels.'

alex (eng-sre): Good call. Add to status summary if space allows.

maya (product): Final: I'll post the summary to statuspage at 2026-03-15T09:00 UTC pending Lena's signoff. If anything changes, update this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
